name: Costa Rican
description:
La Pastura coffee is from the world-famous coffee region of Tarrazú, Costa Rica in Central America. Tarrazú is nestled within the country’s inner mountains where innovative coffee cultivation processing methods and technology are utilized. It boasts flavors of dark cherries, prunes, cocoa nibs, and notes of a Merlot red wine..   
   Origin  - Cooperative Tarrazu, Costa Rica  
   Process  - Washed   
   Roast  - Medium
[Meta Description]: Awaken your senses with our vibrant and lively Costa Rican Coffee. Sourced from the lush coffee farms of Costa Rica for a truly memorable cup.

name: Ethiopian Heirloom
description:
The Organic Ethiopian heirloom coffee grows on a pristine lot, situated on a shady hill with a natural spring, and it is being nurtured by the people at M.S. Estate in Chikmagalur, Karnataka. The sweet natural water of the spring coupled with the jackfruit and citrus trees surrounding the lot add to the terroir and ultimately to the complex flavors of the bean. This coffee boasts bright, fruity, and floral notes that allure you to come back for more. 
   Origin  - M.S. Estate, Chikmagalur  
   Process  - Washed   
   Roast  - Medium
[Meta Description]: Embark on a journey of flavor with our exotic Ethiopian Heirloom Coffee. Discover unique and complex taste profiles in every cup.

name: Kodai Natural
description:

  Origin -   Anughraha Estates, Kodaikanal  
  Process -   Naturals

name: Kodai Reserve
description:
From the misty hills of Kodai comes a cup that celebrates craft and innovation. 
 Our Kodai Reserve undergoes anaerobic fermentation, a process where coffee cherries are fermented without oxygen, allowing wild, fruity flavors to fully develop. This process brings out vibrant berry-like notes and a layered complexity that lingers with every sip. The result is a coffee that feels both bold and refined, offering an indulgent tasting experience unlike any other. 
  Origin -    Anughraha Estates, Kodaikanal  
  Process -    Anaerobic Naturals   
  Roast -    Medium
[Meta Description]: Experience the limited-edition Anaerobic Coffee from Kodaikanal, bursting with raspberry and pomegranate notes. A delightful choice for coffee connoisseurs.

name: Monsooned Malabar
description:
Monsooned Malabar Arabica coffee offers a unique flavor profile due to the exposure of the beans to the monsoon rains and winds for a period of three to four months. The coffee acquired its name from what originally was a natural process happening on the Malabar Coast of south India. The flavors one might taste are reminiscent of cocoa and spices.   
   Origin  - Karnataka  
   Process  - Monsooned   
   Roast  - Light
[Meta Description]: Delight in the earthy and distinct flavors of Monsooned Malabar Coffee. Experience the unique taste of Indian monsooned coffee beans.

name: Sarchimor
description:
Another organic coffee from the Hills of Kodaikanal 
 A wonderfully sweet and nutty cup. Prominent notes of toasted almond give way to a rich, buttery mouthfeel, perfectly balanced by a smooth, lingering honey and vanilla finish
